verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents bounce/complaint handling, open/click tracking, webhooks for real-time events, and even an inbox placement/seed-list testing feature, plus IP pool management for sender reputation — but these are presented as raw feature/data capabilities rather than an integrated analytics dashboard offering guidance or recommendations. Community feedback praises logging/dashboards for debugging but doesn't mention reputation guidance or placement recommendations. missing for 10: evidence of proactive guidance/recommendations tied to reputation scores, a unified analytics view combining bounce/complaint/engagement with actionable insights, and independent confirmation that inbox placement/reputation guidance (beyond raw seed-list testing) is delivered.
